findings.title: XLSX central directory entry count is invalid
findings.finding: xlsx-exporter zip writes EOCD entry counts8 while providing5entries. Synthetic xlsxBytes output declares8; unzip -t validates five members then fails missing file6,exit3. Existing nine export safety tests do not detect this packaging defect.
findings.repair_acceptance: Derive ZIP entry counts from actual entries; independently validate generated archive and open workbook with a standards-aware reader, preserving escaping and dataset parity.

findings.title: File service lacks application composition
findings.finding: Recursive src search finds FileService declaration only; instantiation occurs in integration tests. Library validation/scanning/parent authorization therefore does not establish deployed evidence upload/download workflows.
findings.repair_acceptance: Wire an authorized application upload/download path only after approved scanner/storage policy; verify parent IDOR denial, integrity, object/database compensation and audit with isolated fixtures.

findings.title: Mobile breadcrumb overlaps user menu
findings.finding: Live authenticated dashboard at320CSSpx has breadcrumb rectangle x68,width73.1875,y12,height44 and user menu x71.773,width232.2266,y12,height39.5. These intersect despite document scrollWidth320. Task register and create form also reflow without horizontal document overflow; that does not establish header usability.
findings.repair_acceptance: Reflow or truncate header context without hiding account/navigation controls; verify nonoverlap, touch target usability and keyboard access at320,375,768 and desktop widths.
